metric_definitions.berth_utilization: productive berth-hours divided by productive plus reserved uncertainty berth-hours
metric_definitions.average_waiting_hours: arrival-weighted congestion delay plus one-half of the reserved uncertainty buffer
metric_definitions.scenario_energy_cost: hourly grid energy times tariff, with BESS state reset and terminal BESS plus deferred-load energy settled at the declared reference price for each UTC day

attribution.berth_utilization_and_waiting: The reported berth and waiting differences are mechanically induced by the predeclared 4 h versus 2 h uncertainty-buffer scenario. The buffer was not learned from outcomes and the comparison is not a causal estimate.
attribution.energy_cost: The reported cost difference is produced by the disclosed deterministic BESS and flexible-load schedule, including daily terminal energy settlement; it is not evidence of a trained RL policy outperforming the baseline.
attribution.throughput: Throughput is held identical between baseline and candidate; the benchmark does not claim incremental handled volume.

claim_text.zh: 在固定公开数据驱动、参数预声明的数字孪生情景对照中，相对静态FCFS与固定能源时刻表，协调情景使泊位利用率相对提升9%，平均待泊时间缩短17%，情景用电成本降低12%。

engineering_derivatives: hourly allocation of monthly vessel arrivals

release_gate.wording_required: 固定公开数据驱动、参数预声明的数字孪生情景对照，非港口实测KPI或因果效果
